description: Research starter: searches English Wikipedia (not the open web) for a query and returns the top articles with their summary text, description and last edit time. No AI synthesis; the caller reads and combines the sources. Choose this tool for: Research starter: searches English Wikipedia for a query. Close alternatives on this server: agent_intel_prompt_injection_firewall (Screens one text for prompt-injection patterns in English); agent_intel_viral_trending_radar (Today's trending Google searches for one country: rank).
